description: This source file defines a Configuration class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling the 'use_arn_region' configuration option related to AWS S3's ARN regions. It contains methods for constructing the configuration, validating the input, and retrieving or converting the configuration to an array.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class representing the configuration for using ARN regions in AWS S3, allowing for validation and serialization of the 'use_arn_region' boolean setting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object, validates the 'use_arn_region' value, and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isUseArnRegion
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration is set to use the ARN region.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the configuration object to an associative array suitable for further processing or serialization.
